fix_subject: Fix tab names and add tab tooltips.
defect: The tab name is built with arg(db->metadata()->name().arg(filename)), so arg is applied to the name instead of the format string and the tab text is wrong.
The tab name uses QString('%1 [%2]').arg(name().arg(filename)) with a misplaced parenthesis, so %2 is never filled and the tab shows a literal '[%2]'.

fix_subject: Fix expiry time and bool not being updated.
defect: saveEntry calls setExpires and setExpiryTime on the temporary returned by Entry::timeInfo(), so the expiry changes are thrown away.
saveEntry calls setExpires and setExpiryTime on entry->timeInfo(), which returns a TimeInfo by value, so the expiry changes are applied to a temporary and lost.

fix_subject: Fix syntax error.
defect: Misplaced parenthesis: 'if (!fileKey.load(path), &errorMsg)' calls load without the error pointer and uses the comma operator, so the condition is always true and the error message is never captured.
if (!fileKey.load(...), &errorMsg) misplaces the parenthesis, so the error string is not passed and the condition is the always-true comma expression.

fix_subject: Fix use of wrong slot when connecting the close request signal of the database widget.
defect: The DatabaseWidget closeRequest signal is connected to closeDatabase(), which closes the current tab, instead of closeDatabaseFromSender(), which closes the requesting database.
The database widget's closeRequest signal is connected to closeDatabase(), which closes the current tab, instead of closeDatabaseFromSender(), so the wrong database can be closed.

fix_subject: Fix checking if database has a key.
defect: The replacement condition 'else if (m_db->hasKey())' is inverted: cancelling the key dialog closes databases that have a key and keeps ones that do not.
updateMasterKey closes the database when the user cancels and the database does have a key, the inverse of the previous no-key check.

fix_subject: Fix command line argument parsing.
defect: Argument parsing starts at index 0, the program path, which always exists, so the executable itself is treated as the database filename.
The argument loop starts at index 0, so the program's own executable path (which exists as a file) is taken as the database filename.

fix_subject: Fix transform round benchmark.
defect: QByteArray('\x7E', 32) and QByteArray('\x4B', 32) call QByteArray(int size, char ch) with swapped arguments, producing a 126-byte key and a 75-byte AES-256 seed, so the benchmark runs on wrong-sized data.

QByteArray('\x7E', 32) calls QByteArray(int size, char ch) with swapped arguments, creating a 126-byte array of spaces for the key and a 75-byte seed instead of 32 bytes, so the benchmark runs with a wrong key and seed.

fix_subject: Fix composite keys in KeePass1Reader.
defect: For a password plus key file, KeePass1Key::rawKey hashes the raw password bytes instead of SHA256(password), giving the wrong composite key for KeePass 1 databases.
For a password plus key file, rawKey hashes the raw password bytes together with the key file data instead of the SHA-256 of the password, giving the wrong composite key.

fix_subject: Fix memory leak in Entry::truncateHistory().
defect: truncateHistory allocates 'new QList<QByteArray>()' for foundAttachements and never deletes it, leaking on every call.
truncateHistory allocates foundAttachements with new QList and never deletes it, leaking memory on every call.

fix_subject: Fix enabled state of group actions.
defect: The new updateGroupActions() slot takes no group and only updates the delete action, so the new New/Edit group context actions stay enabled with no current group (e.g. in search) and dereference a null group.
The new context menu's updateGroupActions() only updates the delete action, so 'Add new group' and 'Edit group' stay enabled with no group selected or during search.

fix_subject: Fix clipboard timeout.
defect: The clear-clipboard timeout read from config is in seconds but is passed to QTimer::start() as milliseconds, so the clipboard is cleared after ~10 ms instead of 10 s.
The clipboard timeout read from the config is in seconds but is passed to QTimer::start as milliseconds, so the clipboard is cleared after 10 ms instead of 10 s.

fix_subject: Fix history view showing wrong item.
defect: After a sort proxy is put in front of the history view, view indices are still passed straight to the source model, so activating, showing, restoring or deleting acts on the wrong history item.

A QSortFilterProxyModel is put between the history view and the model, but view indexes are still passed to m_historyModel without mapToSource, so the wrong history item is shown, restored or deleted after sorting.

fix_subject: Fix extra check that wasn't needed
defect: When AutoSaveAfterEveryChange is on, every modification wipes the LastDatabases config entry (the recent databases list).
With AutoSaveAfterEveryChange enabled, every database modification clears the LastDatabases setting, wiping the recent-databases list.

fix_subject: Fix StringField copy.
defect: StringField::operator= assigns m_key = m_key and m_value = m_value (self-assignment), so assigned StringFields keep their old or empty contents.
StringField::operator= assigns m_key = m_key and m_value = m_value, so assignment copies nothing.

fix_subject: Fix EntryView not emitting activated() signals on return key press.
defect: The new keyPressEvent consumes Enter/Return without passing it to QTreeView, so the view no longer emits activated(), which AutoTypeSelectDialog relies on.
The new keyPressEvent swallows Enter/Return without passing it to QTreeView, so the activated() signal is no longer emitted and AutoTypeSelectDialog, which relies on it, stops reacting to Return.

fix_subject: Fix compatibility with Qt < 4.7.
defect: The new test uses QDateTime::setMSecsSinceEpoch, which does not exist in Qt 4.6, the minimum Qt version the build accepts, so the tests fail to compile there.
The new testClone uses QDateTime::setMSecsSinceEpoch, which exists only since Qt 4.7, so the tests fail to compile on the supported Qt 4.6.

fix_subject: Fix copy custom attributes menu.
defect: m_countDefaultAttributes already counts the separator in the copy-attribute menu, so the loop starting at m_countDefaultAttributes + 1 never deletes the first custom attribute action and the entries accumulate.

m_countDefaultAttributes counts all menu actions including the separator, but the loop still starts at count + 1, so the first custom-attribute action is never deleted and entries pile up in the menu.

fix_subject: Fix the temporary filename template so that the original suffix is preserved.
defect: The QTemporaryFile template has no XXXXXX placeholder, so Qt appends a random suffix and the opened attachment loses its file extension.
The QTemporaryFile template is the plain filename without XXXXXX, so Qt appends the random part after the extension and the opened temp file loses its suffix, so the right application is not chosen.

fix_subject: Fix lock file handling in saveDatabaseAs().
defect: saveDatabaseAs overwrites dbStruct.lockFile without deleting the old lock (leaking it and keeping the old file locked), takes the new lock only after writing, and never asks about an existing lock.
saveDatabaseAs overwrites dbStruct.lockFile with a new QLockFile without deleting the old one (leaking it and keeping the old file locked) and ignores a failed tryLock on the target.

fix_subject: Fix lock file location in saveDatabaseAs().
defect: The lock file path now uses fileInfo.canonicalPath() before the file is written, which is empty for a new file, so the lock file lands in the wrong place.
The lock file path is now built from canonicalPath() before the target file exists, which returns an empty string for a new file, so the lock file is created at the wrong location.

fix_subject: Fixed compile error on Mac
defect: QStandardPaths::writableLocation(QDesktopServices::AppDataLocation) uses a non-existent QDesktopServices enumerator (and the QDesktopServices include was removed), so non-X11 builds such as Mac fail to compile.

QStandardPaths::writableLocation is called with QDesktopServices::AppDataLocation, which does not exist (and QDesktopServices is no longer included), so the non-X11 branch fails to compile on Mac and Windows.

fix_subject: Fix another small memory leak.
defect: isAvailable() calls getKeyboard(), which allocates an XkbDesc via XkbGetKeyboard, and never frees the result, leaking it.
isAvailable() calls getKeyboard() only to test it and never frees the returned XkbDescPtr, leaking it.

fix_subject: Fix KeePass2Repair to retain multi-byte UTF-8 chars.
defect: Using a signed char for 'ch < 0x20' makes every byte >= 0x80 negative, so the repair strips all multi-byte UTF-8 characters from the XML.
The byte is read into a plain char, which is signed on common platforms, so every byte >= 0x80 compares < 0x20 and all multi-byte UTF-8 characters are stripped.

fix_subject: Corrected nullptr crash on Windows when going to sleep
defect: On WM_POWERBROADCAST the code treats lParam as a POWERBROADCAST_SETTING without checking wParam == PBT_POWERSETTINGCHANGE, dereferencing a null lParam when the system goes to sleep.

Every WM_POWERBROADCAST message's lParam is treated as a POWERBROADCAST_SETTING pointer without checking wParam == PBT_POWERSETTINGCHANGE, so other power events (e.g. suspend, lParam 0) dereference a null pointer.

fix_subject: Fix CLI help and version options. (#650)
defect: Commenting out parser.process(app) and dispatching on argv[1] means --help and --version are treated as an invalid command name instead of being handled.
Commenting out parser.process() and dispatching on argv[1] means --help and --version are no longer handled and are reported as invalid commands.

fix_subject: Fix edit entry header entity encoding
defect: HTML-escaping the group name and entry title in the edit-entry headline shows entities such as & literally because the headline is shown as plain text.
The added toHtmlEscaped() calls on the edit-entry headline show HTML entities such as & literally, because the header QLabel renders that text as plain (auto-detected) text.

fix_subject: fix RecentDatabases, closes #386
defect: The new recent-databases list on the welcome screen is filled only once in the constructor, so it goes stale as databases are opened and closed (and only reacts to double-click).
The recent-databases list on the welcome screen is filled only once in the constructor (and opened only by double-click), so it stays stale after the history is cleared.

fix_subject: Fix Host header always having port 65535 when URI does not contain explicit port
defect: QUrl::port() returns -1 when no port is given, which stored in a quint16 becomes 65535, so the Host header always carries :65535.
QUrl::port() returns -1 when no port is given, which stored in quint16 becomes 65535, so the Host header always carries port 65535.

fix_subject: :bug: Really set the shortcut for "New database" to Ctrl+Shift+N
defect: Using setShortcut(actionDatabaseNew, QKeySequence::New, Ctrl+Shift+N) keeps the platform's standard New key (Ctrl+N), so New database does not get Ctrl+Shift+N and clashes with New entry.

The change keeps setShortcut(actionDatabaseNew, QKeySequence::New, Ctrl+Shift+N), which uses the platform's standard New key (Ctrl+N), so New Database still gets Ctrl+N and clashes with the new entry shortcut Ctrl+N.

fix_subject: Fix funny resizing bug and increase min-padding
defect: sizeHint is derived from sizeHintForColumn, which comes from the delegate's sizeHint, which in turn grows with the list widget's width, creating a feedback loop that keeps resizing the widget.
The delegate's size hint grows with the list widget's current width and sizeHint feeds that back into the widget width, so the category list keeps resizing itself.

fix_subject: Fix unit test crash
defect: KEEPASSXC_MAIN_WINDOW dereferences qobject_cast<Application*>(qApp) without a null check, crashing when qApp is not an Application (e.g. in unit tests).
The KEEPASSXC_MAIN_WINDOW macro dereferences qobject_cast<Application*>(qApp) without a null check, crashing when qApp is a plain QApplication such as in unit tests.

fix_subject: Fix OSX El Capitan compilation issue
defect: Initialising CGEventFlags (an enum type in the OS X 10.11 SDK) from 0 and from the int constants shiftKey/cmdKey/optionKey/controlKey does not compile on El Capitan.
CGEventFlags variables are initialized from int literals and Carbon modifier constants, which does not compile with SDKs (OS X El Capitan) where CGEventFlags is an enum type.

fix_subject: Fix GoogleFallback/Screnlock settings
defect: loadSettings loads the new IconDownloadFallbackToGoogle setting into lockDatabaseOnScreenLockCheckBox instead of fallbackToGoogle (copy-paste error), clobbering the screen-lock checkbox and never showing the fallback setting.

loadSettings sets lockDatabaseOnScreenLockCheckBox from IconDownloadFallbackToGoogle instead of fallbackToGoogle, so the screen-lock setting is overwritten and the Google fallback checkbox is never loaded.

fix_subject: Fix wrong reply size in NativeMessagingBase
defect: The reply length prefix uses QString::length() (UTF-16 units) instead of the UTF-8 byte count, so messages with non-ASCII characters get the wrong size.
sendReply writes the QString length in UTF-16 code units as the message size but sends UTF-8 bytes, so non-ASCII replies get a wrong length prefix.

fix_subject: Fix compilation error
defect: The benchmark lambda captures 'this' but never uses it, which triggers clang's -Wunused-lambda-capture and breaks the build under the project's -Wall -Werror flags.
The benchmark lambda captures this without using it, which is an unused-lambda-capture warning that breaks the -Werror build with clang.

fix_subject: Fix KDBX4 reader/writer attachment mapping error Write duplicate attachments to the binary inner header only once and skip duplicate entries when reading a KDBX4 file. This fixes a an attachment mapping problem when an attachment appears more than once in a database (which occurs frequently when editing attachment entries and history is turned on)
defect: writeAttachments writes every attachment occurrence to the inner header, while KdbxXmlWriter numbers only unique attachment data, so attachment references point to the wrong binaries when data is duplicated (e.g. in history).

writeAttachments writes every attachment of every entry (including history duplicates) to the inner header, while the XML writer references binaries by deduplicated index, so attachment references point at the wrong binaries.

fix_subject: Fix file selection filter on *nix systems
defect: On non-Windows systems the proxy file dialog filter is *.*, which hides executables that have no extension.
On non-Windows systems the file dialog filter '*.*' only shows files containing a dot, hiding typical extensionless executables so the proxy binary cannot be selected.

fix_subject: fix duplicate autotype sequences
defect: autoTypeSequences appends a sequence for every matching association, title match and URL match, so the same entry and sequence show up several times in the global auto-type selection.
autoTypeSequences no longer stops after the first match, so title and URL matches can append the same effective sequence several times, producing duplicate matches in the global auto-type selection.

fix_subject: Fix keepass-browser based popups on tiling WMs
defect: The added setWindowFlags(WindowStaysOnTopHint) is called after show()/activateWindow()/raise(), which re-hides the dialog so the association popup does not appear on tiling window managers.
setWindowFlags is called after show/activateWindow/raise, which hides and re-creates the dialog so the association popup does not appear on some window managers.

fix_subject: Fix inconsistent mutex unlocking due to double slot execution, fixes #1561
defect: Converting m_inAutoType to a QMutex makes resetInAutoType and performAutoTypeFromGlobal unlock it unconditionally, so when both select-dialog slots run the mutex is unlocked twice or while not locked.
resetInAutoType() and the other paths unlock the new QMutex unconditionally, and the select dialog's rejected() can fire twice, so an unlocked mutex gets unlocked again (undefined behaviour).

fix_subject: SSH Agent: Fix wrong slot reference (#1787)
defect: The new connect targets a nonexistent slot updateAttachments(), so attachment changes never refresh the SSH agent list and Qt prints a connect error.
The new connect uses SLOT(updateAttachments()), which does not exist; the new function is updateSSHAgentAttachments(), so the connection fails at runtime and attachments do not update.

fix_subject: Fixed regression
defect: The change declares removeIdentity(OpenSSHKey&) const while the definition in SSHAgent.cpp stays non-const (and assigns m_error), so the SSH agent build no longer compiles.
removeIdentity is declared const in the header, but its definition is non-const and assigns m_error, so the declaration does not match the definition and the SSH agent build fails.

fix_subject: Fix windows building
defect: The added setsockopt call passes an int* where Windows expects const char* and lacks the Winsock2 include, breaking the Windows build.
The added setsockopt call passes an int* option value and has no Winsock include, so the code does not compile on Windows.

fix_subject: Fix to apply "Hide toolbar" without restart
defect: The Hide toolbar setting is read only in the MainWindow constructor, so changing it in the settings has no effect until restart.
The Hide toolbar setting is applied only once in the constructor, so changing it in the settings has no effect until restart.

fix_subject: Fix Match URL scheme setting
defect: The new scheme check skips any entry whose scheme differs from the site's even when 'Match URL scheme' is off, e.g. scheme-less or http entries for an https site.
searchEntries always skips entries whose URL scheme differs from the request's (including entries stored without a scheme), ignoring the Match URL scheme setting.

fix_subject: Fix issues with TOTP
defect: saveSettings reads the 8-digit radio and the step spin box even when Default or Steam is selected and builds fresh settings, dropping the OTP-url format, so the TOTP settings are saved incorrectly.

saveSettings builds fresh settings (otpUrl false, step always from the spin box), so for an entry with an otp attribute Entry::setTotp overwrites it with step;digits text, destroying the key, and a custom step leaks into default mode.

fix_subject: Minor bug fixes and formatting
defect: update() hides the password generator and resets the toggle only when there is no group, so switching to another group keeps a stale open generator and shown-password state.

update() only hides the password generator and resets its toggle when no group is set, and never resets the show-password toggle, so generator and visibility state carry over to the next edited group.

fix_subject: Fixed issues detected by test suite and ci
defect: deserialize reads attribute 'Trusted' though serialize writes 'Trust', treats QString::compare's non-zero (unequal) result as a match, and misspells 'Unrusted', so trust is never read back correctly.

deserialize reads the old Trusted attribute instead of the Trust attribute that serialize writes, treats a nonzero compare() as a match, misspells Untrusted and lets the else overwrite the Trusted case, so trust values do not round-trip.

fix_subject: Fix conditional build flags for yubikey and keeshare
defect: m_shareLabel is declared only under WITH_XC_KEESHARE, but the same commit uses it unconditionally in DatabaseWidget::search(), so the build fails without KeeShare.
m_shareLabel is declared only under WITH_XC_KEESHARE but DatabaseWidget.cpp (same commit) uses it unguarded in search mode, so builds without KeeShare fail to compile.

fix_subject: Prevent crash when editing master key
defect: The new isEmpty() reads m_compUi->enterPasswordEdit, which is only created when the edit page is set up, so calling it while the widget is not on the edit page dereferences an uninitialised UI pointer and crashes.
The new isEmpty() reads m_compUi->enterPasswordEdit even when the edit page was never set up (setupUi runs only in componentEditWidget), so it crashes when editing the master key.

fix_subject: Fix double password edit field
defect: The new componentWidgetLayout->isEmpty() test is also true when the existing component widget is merely hidden, so a second edit widget is added and a double password field appears.

resetComponentEditWidget now creates a new edit widget whenever componentWidgetLayout->isEmpty(), which is also true when the existing widget is merely hidden, so a second password field is added on show.

fix_subject: Fix #3259 Use QUrl::fromUserInput to parse a url with correct scheme
defect: Replacing entry->webUrl() with QUrl(entry->url()) drops the automatic scheme, so URLs stored without a scheme (e.g. example.com) no longer open in the browser.
openUrlForEntry now uses QUrl(entry->url()) instead of webUrl(), so URLs without a scheme such as example.com are parsed as relative paths and do not open in the browser.

fix_subject: Fix stylesheet warnings introduced by 3b330ee2 (#3610)
defect: updateStylesheet sets 'QLineEdit { background: %1; }' with the %1 placeholder unfilled when not in verify mode or when passwords match, producing an invalid stylesheet.
updateStylesheet sets the template QLineEdit { background: %1; } with an unreplaced %1 when passwords match or no base edit exists, producing an invalid stylesheet and Qt parse warnings.

fix_subject: Fix unused variable error when building without WITH_XC_YUBIKEY.
defect: The new yubiKeySlot parameter is unused when WITH_XC_YUBIKEY is off, which with -Wextra and -Werror (debug builds) breaks compilation.
The new yubiKeySlot parameter is only used inside #ifdef WITH_XC_YUBIKEY, so builds without YubiKey get an unused-parameter warning, which is an error in Debug builds (-Werror).

fix_subject: Fix zxcvbn include for out-of-tree compilation, resolves #3658
defect: The new file includes zxcvbn/zxcvbn.h, which only resolves relative to the source tree and breaks out-of-tree builds.
The new file includes "zxcvbn/zxcvbn.h", unlike the rest of the code base, which uses <zxcvbn.h>, so out-of-tree or system-zxcvbn builds fail.

fix_subject: Fix TOTP Dialog not closing on lock
defect: connect(parent, SIGNAL(lockedDatabase()), ...) names a signal that does not exist (DatabaseWidget emits databaseLocked()), so the TOTP dialog never closes on lock.
The dialog connects to a non-existent signal lockedDatabase() instead of DatabaseWidget::databaseLocked(), so the TOTP dialog never closes on lock.

fix_subject: Fix subdomain matching
defect: handleURL now tests entryQUrl.host().endsWith(baseDomain(hostname)), so every entry under the same base domain matches regardless of subdomain.

handleURL now matches when the entry host ends with the site's base domain, so any entry on the same base domain matches regardless of subdomain (e.g. a.example.com credentials offered on b.example.com).

fix_subject: Fix base domain matching
defect: handleURL now accepts an entry when siteQUrl.host().endsWith(entryQUrl.host()) with no domain boundary, so an entry for example.com matches unrelated hosts like evilexample.com.
handleURL matches when the site host merely ends with the entry host, so an entry for example.com matches a site like badexample.com and credentials are offered to another domain.

fix_subject: Fix crash upon exiting interactive mode if there is no current database.
defect: The added currentDatabase->releaseData() calls dereference a null shared pointer when interactive mode is exited without an open database.
The added currentDatabase->releaseData() calls on exit dereference a null QSharedPointer when no database is open, so the CLI crashes.

fix_subject: Fix compile error on certain platforms
defect: Info.cpp uses asConst() without including core/Global.h, relying on transitive includes, so it fails to compile on some platforms.
Info.cpp uses asConst without including core/Global.h, so it fails to compile on platforms where the header is not pulled in transitively.

fix_subject: Prevent crash if focus widget gets deleted during saving
defect: A raw pointer to qApp->focusWidget() is stored across QApplication::processEvents() and the save, then dereferenced, crashing if that widget was deleted meanwhile.

A raw QWidget* from qApp->focusWidget() is kept across processEvents() and the save, and setFocus() is called on it afterwards even if the widget was deleted meanwhile, causing a use-after-free crash.

fix_subject: Fix DatabaseTabWidget::lockDatabases returns false even when all tabs are locked
defect: lockDatabases returns numLocked == count() after closing tabs for file-less databases, so count() has shrunk and the function reports failure even when all databases were locked.
lockDatabases compares numLocked with count() after closing file-less tabs, so it returns false even when all databases were locked and closeAllDatabaseTabs aborts.

fix_subject: Fix resolving resources when running from build directory
defect: The new resource-dir probe requires icons/application/256x256/apps/keepassxc.png, which a build-directory share folder lacks now that icons are bundled, so the data path (wordlists, translations) is not found when running from the build directory.

The new data-dir detection requires icons/application/256x256/apps/keepassxc.png and drops the source-dir fallback, so when running from the build directory (whose share folder has no such icon) no data path is found and wordlists/translations are not resolved.

fix_subject: Fix auto-start settings on Windows
defect: setLaunchAtStartup writes applicationFilePath() to the Run key unquoted and with forward slashes, so autostart fails for paths with spaces (e.g. Program Files) or non-native separators.
The Run registry value is set to the unquoted applicationFilePath with forward slashes, so autostart fails when the path contains spaces.

fix_subject: Fix browser socket path for proxy and app
defect: localServerPath builds the socket name from qApp's KPXC_QUALIFIED_APPNAME property, which only main.cpp sets, so keepassxc-proxy computes a different (empty-name) socket path than the application.
The browser socket name is built from the KPXC_QUALIFIED_APPNAME application property, which differs or is missing in keepassxc-proxy, so the proxy and the app use different socket paths.

fix_subject: Fix heap-use-after-free & error-msg output in keepassxc-cli
defect: Replacing the per-iteration local error TextStream (flushed on destruction) with the global buffered Utils::STDERR and a plain "\n" means 'Unknown command' errors in interactive mode are not flushed and do not appear.
Replacing the per-iteration local TextStream (flushed on destruction) with the persistent Utils::STDERR stream and terminating with plain newline leaves the 'Unknown command' message unflushed.

fix_subject: Fix Best-Matching ..again (#5316)
defect: With best-match enabled, the added handleURL branch rejects entries unless host and path match exactly, so entries saved as a plain domain or subdomain no longer match pages with a path; the new fullUrl priority also compares an unnormalized URL.

With best-match-only enabled, handleURL now accepts an entry only if host and path match exactly or the entry path is a longer prefix, so plain-domain entries (no path) or subdomain matches are filtered out and no credentials are returned.

fix_subject: Fix auto-restart when a space is in the file path
defect: The restart uses QProcess::start(QString) with the application path as one command string, which Qt splits on spaces, so the restart fails when the path contains a space.
Restart uses QProcess::start(QString), which parses the string as a command line and so fails when the executable path contains spaces (and the child QProcess is never detached).

fix_subject: Fix AutoOpen IfDevice matching, again
defect: The added else branch sets loadDb = false for any non-matching device name, so an earlier match is overwritten (e.g. IfDevice 'A,B' never opens on A).

The rewritten IfDevice loop sets loadDb to false for every listed device that does not match, so with several positive device names the result depends on the last one and a matching machine may not open the database.

fix_subject: Fix removing encrypted ASN.1 keys from ssh-agent (#6804)
defect: The change dropped the '|| key.publicParts().isEmpty()' clause, so encrypted ASN.1/PEM keys (whose public part is only available after decryption) are no longer opened when decrypt is false, breaking their removal from ssh-agent.

The condition for opening an encrypted key was reduced to 'decrypt' only, dropping the case where the public parts are empty, so encrypted ASN.1 keys without a public key are never decrypted and cannot be removed from the agent.

fix_subject: Fix infinite save bug when saving fails
defect: markAsModified no longer checks whether modified signals are enabled before starting the modified timer, so modifications while emitting is blocked still emit and cause infinite saving with auto-save.

markAsModified no longer checks whether modified signals are enabled and always starts the modified timer, so modifications while emitting is blocked still emit databaseModified, causing endless saves with autosave after failed saves.

fix_subject: Fix broken browser integration since #6899 (#7030)
defect: isValidUuid rejects UUIDs whose RFC 4122 version field is unknown, but KeePass entry UUIDs are arbitrary 16 random bytes, so valid entries are rejected and browser integration breaks.
isValidUuid rejects UUIDs whose version is VerUnknown, but KeePassXC entry UUIDs are random bytes without RFC 4122 version bits, so valid entry UUIDs are rejected and browser integration breaks.

fix_subject: Fix new password generator closed reply with Browser Integration (#7359)
defect: The generator popup's closed handler always sends the error message to the browser, even after a password was generated and sent.
The generator's closed handler always sends the error message to the extension, even after a password was generated and applied, so the extension gets an error reply after a successful generation.

fix_subject: Fix syntax issue & add a missing header (#7160)
defect: 'static const CustomData::CustomDataItem NULL_ITEM;' default-initializes a const object of a type without a user-provided constructor, which AppleClang 7/8 reject, breaking the build.
The added 'static const CustomData::CustomDataItem NULL_ITEM;' default-initializes a const object of a type without a user-provided constructor, which AppleClang 7/8 reject as a compile error.

fix_subject: Fix syntax issue & add a missing header (#7160)
defect: 'static const Metadata::CustomIconData NULL_ICON;' default-initializes a const aggregate without a user-provided constructor, a compile error on AppleClang 7/8.
The added 'static const Metadata::CustomIconData NULL_ICON;' default-initializes a const aggregate without an initializer, which AppleClang 7/8 reject.

fix_subject: Fix excluding characters in password generator
defect: The excluded-characters text is passed to setCustomCharacterSet, overwriting the additional characters and never excluding anything.
The excluded-characters field is passed to setCustomCharacterSet, overwriting the additional characters and adding the characters that should be excluded.

fix_subject: Fix wrong DACL memory size on Windows (createWindowsDACL) (#10712)
defect: The DACL size adds GetLengthSid(pOwnerRightsSid) but not another sizeof(ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE) for the new owner-rights ACE, so the ACL buffer is too small when three ACEs are added (with WITH_XC_SSHAGENT).
The DACL size adds GetLengthSid of the new owner-rights SID but no sizeof(ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE) for its ACE, so the ACL is too small for three ACEs when the SSH agent ACE is also added.

fix_subject: Fix signal/slot disconnect when opening import wizard
defect: disconnect(dbWidget, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr) removes every connection of each open DatabaseWidget, breaking the rest of the application's signal wiring.
disconnect(dbWidget, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr) removes every connection of each open DatabaseWidget, including the main window's, and not just the wizard's own.

fix_subject: Database key settings: fix UI bug
defect: isEmpty() now returns true whenever the edit page is not visible, even when a password was entered, so the database key settings apply an empty password when other key components change.
isEmpty() was changed to return true whenever the edit page is not visible, so an unchanged existing password is reported as empty and an empty password is applied when other key components change.

fix_subject: Fix copy-to-clipboard shortcut on macOS
defect: The per-QAction event filter added to handle the copy shortcut never fires on macOS, so Copy Password still overrides copying the selected text there.
The Ctrl/Cmd+C selected-text handling was moved into an event filter on QActions, which never fires on macOS, so copying selected text there copies the password instead.

fix_subject: Fix rendering & and " in preview panel
defect: Calling toHtmlEscaped() on the title and the plain password before setText on auto-format labels makes text without markup display literally as '&' or '"'.
Adding toHtmlEscaped to the title, URL and non-coloured password labels double-escapes text in labels that render it as plain text, so characters like & and quotes show as & and ".

fix_subject: Fix loose URL comparison
defect: The new loose-comparison branch of isUrlValid rejects any URL without a dot, so valid hosts such as https://myowndomain:8000 or localhost are reported invalid.
The new loose-comparison check '!url.contains(".")' rejects valid URLs whose host has no dot, such as https://myowndomain:8000.

fix_subject: Fix minor issues with tags context menu
defect: The incremental tags-menu update removes stale actions with deleteLater after the menu's empty check, keeps the No Tags placeholder, reuses actions across databases and appends new tags out of order.

Reusing tag actions across calls with deleteLater removal leaves the disabled No Tags action alive during the isEmpty check, lets a tag named No Tags collide with the placeholder, and appends new tags unsorted when the database changes.
